tips.text: Capture Kubrodons or Stovers solo with an Echo-Lure and pheromones; each pays thousands of standing, and a sleep or invisibility frame like Equinox or Ivara makes the capture perfect.
Mine gems for Smokefinger with a resource-doubling dog or cat; Deck 13 caves have plenty of ore.
Start collecting Training Debt-Bonds early; you need six for the rank-ups and ten more for gilding.
Hold the part builds until you have every material and enough Foundry slots, since each takes 24 hours.
Level it in Hydron, Sedna Defense, with a booster; Grineer enemies give the best affinity.
Fit vitality, armour and shield mods and an Orokin Reactor on it before levelling so it survives.
Level it in easy content; a downed MOA only respawns after 60 seconds, so high-level runs stall.
Donate a rank 30 MOA back to Legs for standing only after the Mastery is banked.
Expect the most expensive companion to set up; the four 24-hour builds, the credits and the Solaris ranking add up, and the Orb Vallis resource loop is the annoying part.
